records.statement: The 2021-2022 Beta RX 300 is a 293.1 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, 72 x 72 mm bore and stroke, 11.4:1 compression, carbureted, electric start, 6-speed, with a centrifugal exhaust valve. Weight ready to ride without fuel is 99.7 kg (47.7 front, 51 rear). Wheelbase 1490 mm, seat height 970 mm, ground clearance 350 mm, footpeg height 430 mm, length 2180 mm. Fuel tank 9.5 litres. Tyres 90/90-21 front and 120/80-19 rear at 1 bar; rims 21x1.6 and 19x1.85, 36 spokes. Brakes: 260 mm front disc with twin-piston floating caliper, 240 mm rear with single-piston caliper. Frame: molybdenum steel double cradle.
Stock carburetor settings on the 2021-2022 RX 300: main jet 172, slow jet 40, start jet 85, needle N1EG in the 3rd position from the top, air screw 1 1/2 turns out from closed. Spark plug NGK BR8ECM.

2021-2022 RX 300 gearing: final drive 14/48, primary 27/72. Gearbox ratios 1st 12/31, 2nd 15/28, 3rd 19/28, 4th 20/24, 5th 27/27, 6th 28/24. Chain: 30 mm of slack measured at the swingarm as shown in the manual; replace the chain when 18 links measure 272 mm or more with the top run pulled tight. Rear axle nut 130 Nm.

2021-2022 RX 300: mix fuel at 2% oil (50:1) for normal use and 2.5% (40:1) for the first tank during break-in; 95 RON petrol. Gearbox oil 800 ml at a normal change, 850 ml after a full engine rebuild. Coolant 1300 ml. Fork oil quantity 525 g per leg for a completely dry fork. Beta USA's listed products are Motul: 800 2T premix oil, Transoil Expert 10W-40 gearbox oil, RBF 600 brake fluid, Factory Line 5 wt fork oil and Motocool Expert coolant.

Beta's break-in for the 2021-2022 RX 300 lasts about 5 hours. First tank at 2.5% premix. For the first 3 hours use about 70% of the power and stay under 11,000 rpm; for the next 2 hours use about 90%. Warm the engine properly and avoid holding a constant speed. Change the gearbox oil after the first 3 hours or 15 litres of fuel. Repeat the procedure whenever the piston, rings, cylinder, crankshaft or crank bearings are replaced.

Beta's schedule for the 2021-2022 RX 300 runs in 30-hour service steps up to 180 hours. Gear and clutch oil: replace at the end of break-in (3 hours) and every 30 hours. Spark plug: check at 3 hours, replace every 60 hours. Piston and rings: replace every 60 hours. Cylinder and reed valve: check every 60 hours. Clutch friction plates and springs: check every 30 hours, replace at 90 and 180 hours. Connecting rod, crankshaft bearings and seals: replace at 90 and 180 hours. Cylinder head bolts: retighten at the end of break-in. Engine mount bolts: check every service. These are Beta's intervals for normal use; hard racing shortens them.

records.statement: The 2024-2026 Beta RX 450 is a 449.3 cc liquid-cooled four-stroke single, 97 x 60.8 mm bore and stroke, 13.4:1 compression, fuel injected with two injectors, electric start, 5-speed. Fuel tank 7 litres. Tyres 80/100-21 front and 110/90-19 rear at 1 bar; rims 21x1.6 and 19x2.15. Brakes: 260 mm front disc with twin-piston floating caliper, 240 mm rear with single-piston caliper. Gear and clutch oil 750 ml at a normal change, 800 ml after a rebuild. Both: Liqui Moly Motorbike 4T Synth 10W-50 Offroad Race. Coolant 1300 ml. Fuel 95 RON. Brake and clutch fluid DOT 5.1. Fork oil KYB 01M, 545 g per leg for a completely dry fork. Spark plug NGK LKAR8A-9, gap 0.5 to 0.6 mm. Throttle cable free play 3 to 5 mm. Wire-mesh oil screen: clean every 10 hours. Paper oil filter: replace after break-in and every 20 hours. Valve clearance: check after break-in and every 20 hours. Spark plug: replace every 40 hours. Piston and rings: replace every 40 hours. Clutch plates: check at 20 and 60 hours, replace at 40 and 80. Cylinder head bolts: retighten after break-in. After the first 100 km check the sprocket, brake disc, caliper and brake pedal bolts. These are intervals for normal use; hard racing shortens them.
